acme's payout is recorded. The remaining customers in the batch are birch and cobalt, so I'll get birch's net balance from net_balance next.
birch's net_balance of 65068 matches my own check: orders 101 and 104 total 65068 with no refunds. I'll record birch's payout now.
Two customers are paid so far, acme and birch. The last customer in the batch is cobalt, so I'll get cobalt's net balance from net_balance.
cobalt's net_balance of 2634 matches my own check: orders 102 and 105 total 38498, less refunds of 2289 and 33575 gives 2634. I'll record cobalt's payout now, which is the last customer in the batch.

All three customers have been paid. I checked each net balance against the orders and refunds: acme 33983, birch 65068, cobalt 2634. The refund ledger matched Alpha Co's report, so the batch is complete.
